name: Dannosaki Camilla
source:
Daughter of a vampire family, she is [url=/c4985]Lamia[/url]'s younger twin sister.

Despite being calm and reassuring, Camilla is unrivaled in cruelty. She is brilliant, she has both brains and beauty.
Camilla is trusted to take care of the family. But because she is very independent and does everything alone, most of the time her family members don't know where she is or what she is doing.
Camilla owns a laptop which she uses mainly for asset management. So far she has been doing it without any incidents. Contrary to her mature expression on her face, she has enough nerves to pull off various crimes.

Things that interest her: Psychology, her computer.
Things she always wanted to see: A tornado.

Interests: psychology, computer.
What she'd like to see: A tornado

[Roughly translated from [url=http://risusoftnosferatu.blog49.fc2.com/blog-entry-4.html]the official website[/url]]
